# Draft:Battle of El Espino (1983)

The Battle of El Espino (1983) was an armed confrontation during the Contra War near the settlement of El Espino in northern Nicaragua.
Background
The area around El Espino was strategically located near supply routes and saw repeated military activity.
Battle
Contra forces attacked Sandinista positions in the vicinity of the town during 1983.
Aftermath
The engagement did not result in a lasting change in control of the area.
